action.objective: Advance c4-c5, driving the black queen back and expanding on the queenside while keeping material balanced.
action.rationale: c4c5 is the only commit_ready move. Verification at effective depth 4 (completed depth 3) gives exact -41, the best exact evidence available. Safety probe is complete for immediate mates (not_found) and the tactical refutation probe found no forced mate. Move facts show the queen cannot profitably capture: after Qxc5+ or Qxb4 the position stays balanced with b4 pawn defending and no material concession. c5 also restricts the black queen and gains central space.
